shared_retrieval_rule.distance: mean absolute normalized feature distance; score=1/(1+distance)

historical_result_budget.interpretation: same observed outcome fields for future T/E; equal bytes do not establish fairness

shared_retrieval_rule.scales: container dimensions, payload; capacity uses max(payload,1); placed volume/container volume
shared_retrieval_rule.truncation: whole entries only; never remove conditions, costs or limitations

shared_caps_and_fields.differences: T normalized historical location detail; E hypotheses and evidence counts; equal caps do not establish information equivalence

historical_result.interpretation: same observed outcome fields for future T/E; equal bytes do not establish fairness

length_unit: characters and UTF-8 bytes (equal for actual ASCII-rendered views)
content_difference: T normalized historical positions; E bounded hypotheses, evidence counts and fewer historical position details
fairness: Same current public facts, candidate and prompt contract; same entry/result caps do not establish information equivalence. No filler/truncating conditions or costs.
